description: Liberia - Cross-border systems Proposed Interconnection Transmission Line is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Shaky Sherpa (Columbia University Earth Institute). A representation Côte d’Ivoire-Liberia-Sierra Leone-Guinea (CLSG) Transmission line which was part of the proposed West Africa Power Pool (WAPP) system was derived from the Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO)- Final Line Route Study Report in January 2010. Coverage: Côte d'Ivoire, Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, SHP. The portal files it under Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2010 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
